title: Felix and the Contact
author: Yara Okonkwo
blurb: Emrys Marchetti, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
